summary: Incyte Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing an agreement with the U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) to align Medicaid pricing for Jakafi and Jakafi XR with a defined group of industrialized nations, and to avoid certain future CMS pricing mandates. The agreement is not expected to affect 2026 financial guidance or have a material impact on future outlook. This is a routine regulatory/pricing arrangement disclosure, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review. No deal terms are stated.
